result.instructions: Tools for billey, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still unpaid, and how many days overdue is each one?"; "Show me all expenses from October 2026 with their VAT amounts."; "List the time entries logged on project X this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes billey data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run billey_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run billey_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run billey_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. billey_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: billey_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients of the book (name, contact, payment terms, collection method). Returns cursor pagination: follow links.next. Use updated_after to sync only changes. billey API: GET /api/v1/clients.

updated_after.description: Only rows updated strictly after this UTC time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z (incremental sync).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to return, e.g. id,invoice_number,total. id is always included.

cursor.description: Cursor from links.next or links.prev of an earlier response.
